June K.: Quick thread: promoting the webinar mini-case 'Latency vs Cost' next Tue. Deliverables: 2 X posts, 1 LinkedIn thread, hero image, 45s clip, and SDR seed rules. Who can pick up pieces?
Arman V.: I9ll own scheduling + SDR routing. Recommend X AM metric lead, X PM customer quote, LinkedIn thread that unpacks key config tips. Also want a tiny headline A/B on X.
Leah P.: I9ll write copy. Tone: technical but punchy. Drafts:
- Metric opener: "Cut inference unit cost 36% while keeping p95 <180ms. Replay + configs: [link]"
- Story opener: "They slashed infra surprises and shipped faster. Watch the 12-min replay. [link]"
Tom S.: Design needs: hero 1200x628 PNG, square thumbnail, and 45s MP4. Please drop slides/screens. ETA?
June K.: SDR seedlist: attendees (auto), replay clickers (UTM), active trials, named accounts. Route high-intent (ARR>8k or enterprise tag) to AE queue. Arman, can you add CRM rules?
Arman V.: Yep. Rules: attendees->SDR-Gen, replay_clickers+active_trials->SDR-Adv, named+ARR>8k->AE. UTM canonical: utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_linkedin&utm_campaign=latency_cost_case.
publish-bot: Scheduled posts: X metric 2026-05-05T09:00Z, X story 2026-05-05T17:00Z, LinkedIn thread 2026-05-05T11:30Z. No conflicts.
Leah P.: Draft LinkedIn thread opener: "How we reduced per-inference spend without trading latency. TL;DR: batching + kv-cache + optimized kernels. Replay + configs: [link]"
Tom S.: Uploaded hero v1 -> https://drive.example/latcost/hero_v1.png. Will push v2 with bolder delta by EOD.
June K.: Owners: Leah(copy), Tom(design/video), Arman(schedule+routing), June(campaign). I'll check back when assets are in the drive and then lock scheduling. Thanks! :rocket:
